title: Reward Index Inflation Due to Rounding Up Can Trap Rewards
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the `_depositPremium` function within `PositionInteractionFacet.sol`, when option premiums are added as rewards for liquidity providers, the `rewards.rewardsPerLPQ128` index is updated using `mulDivRoundingUp`:  ```solidity if (lpSupply > 0) rewards.rewardsPerLPQ128 += upscaledPremium.mulDivRoundingUp(Q128, lpSupply); ```  Using `mulDivRoundingUp` causes the calculated reward added per LP token unit (scaled by `Q128`) to be rounded **up** to the nearest integer in the fixed-point representation.
